about_the_game:
Note: When you purchase this DLC, the Mega Drive version of “Granada” will be added to the launcher and become playable. The Telenet Shooting Collection Launcher is required to play.

Granada (Mega Drive version release date: November 16, 1990)

Legend of Granada, only those who encounter it know the truth…

Pilot the tank-type mobile weapon Granada. Destroy the mission targets scattered across each stage, then defeat the boss that appears at the end to clear it.

A key mechanic is the ability to lock your firing direction, mastering how to attack in directions other than your movement path is the key to victory.

A satisfyingly challenging omni-directional scrolling shooter!
